integrity: All claims are analytical. Finite numerical tests support but do not replace the proof. Standard fixed-pair Gaussian sign-loss formulas and beta distributions are credited to the literature.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two real dimensions, symmetric positive-definite operator, independent Gaussian sketch entries, exact arithmetic, one-dimensional projected scalar signs; not a multivariate Ritz eigenvalue or convergence theorem. The motivating preprint was not available for complete inspection.
title: Exact uniform and fixed-vector sign-loss laws for Gaussian-sketched positive-definite operators
